source: Concordance libconcord/remote_info.h (GPL-3.0) - the table is indexed by SKIN id
_names: Each skin is its own remote and has its own name here, as MyHarmony's catalogue (GetAllProducts, 2026-11-16) lists it - a European skin with "(EMEA)" - so the remote pickers list each one; `on_remote` is what the remote itself calls its model where that differs. The 510 had no name and was listed as a 515.
